name: Sys2Bench
description: Sys2Bench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate inference-time reasoning and planning capabilities of large language models across eleven diverse tasks in five categories, including arithmetic, logical, common sense, algorithmic reasoning, and planning.
reputation: A recent benchmark for inference-time reasoning and planning that has gained attention in the LLM reasoning community.
notes: Focuses on inference-time techniques for reasoning and planning; evaluates tradeoffs between computational cost and performance; covers multiple reasoning categories.
